messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick idea: spin up a 20-30min hands-on refapp sprint for community next Thurs. Aim: faststart tutorial, short benchmark snapshot, and a gated "starter kit" for signups. Low friction. Thoughts?
Leo (DevRel): Love it. I can create the repo skeleton + a tutorial notebook. Prefer CLI + tiny frontend so folks can replicate locally.
Ravi (Eng): I'll do a light benchmark run: cold vs warm cache, and Hosted v Dedicated comparison for cost per 1k tokens. Will keep it 2-3 charts.
Tasha (Growth): We'll need a punchy lead magnet header. Options: "Build an LLM UX in 20 minutes", "From prototype to production-ready inference". Which leans dev-friendly?
Marta (Design): I'll mock 2 landing variants and a GIF hero showing local dev loop. Need repo screenshots from Leo by Tue.
Priya (Marketing): Target deliverables: tutorial + repo, 3 benchmark charts, landing copy, webinar (15m demo + 10m q&a). Who can own the run-of-show?
Leo (DevRel): I'll handle run-of-show. Proposed: 3m intro, 10m demo (walkthrough + live code), 5m benchmarks, 7m Q&A. Keep demo deterministic.
Ravi (Eng): For reproducibility, I'll include this command in the appendix:

```bash
# quick perf sample
python perf/sample_bench.py --model redwood-small --seq-len 256 --batch 2 --warmup 20
```

Ravi (Eng): Environment note: report GPU (A10G), client=redwood-sdk v0.12.1, and quant flags.
Tasha (Growth): Channel plan: community newsletter, OSS repo pinned issue, and a short Twitter thread. We'll gate the starter kit behind a short form (name + github + use case).
Priya (Marketing): CTA flows: immediate download for open-source contributors, gated kit for commercial interest. Also create a tracking utm for each channel.
Leo (DevRel): I'll add a small A/B in the tutorial: caching enabled vs naive calls, and show latency improvement in the README.
Marta (Design): For social clips, record 60s highlight, 30s GIFs for tweets, and 15s demo snippet for Discord.
OpsBot: Heads-up: demo namespace available Thu 3pm-5pm; request by Wed EOD.
Priya (Marketing): Action owners: Leo - repo + run-of-show + screenshots; Ravi - perf + scripts + appendix; Marta - assets; Tasha - landing + registration page; Priya - blog draft + email. Sync Thu morning for final rehearsals. :sparkles:
